# seba1rx/sessionadmin

> PHP 8.1+ library that wraps native PHP sessions with security hardening and URL authorization. Handles session lifecycle (start, authenticate, terminate), hijacking detection, session ID regeneration, and optional URL-based access control for multi-page applications.

## Mental model

```
Every PHP entry point (page or AJAX endpoint)
  └─ $session->activateSession()
        ├─ sets session name + cookie params
        ├─ calls session_start()
        ├─ checks lifetime → destroys if expired
        ├─ checks IP prefix + User-Agent → destroys if mismatch
        ├─ randomly regenerates session ID (~3% of requests)
        ├─ checks URL authorization (MPA only)
        └─ prunes inactive tabs (if tab handler set + autoCleanupTabs > 0)

On login:
  └─ $session->createUserSession($userId)
        ├─ marks $_SESSION['sessionadmin']['isUser'] = true
        └─ regenerates session ID (session fixation prevention)

On logout:
  └─ $session->terminate()
        ├─ wipes $_SESSION
        ├─ destroys and restarts session as guest
        └─ redirects to index.php (MPA only, when $terminateRedirects = true)
```

## Session data structure

```php
$_SESSION['sessionadmin'] = [
    'appType'             => 'SPA',         // 'SPA' | 'MPA'
    'isUser'              => false,         // true after createUserSession()
    'id_user'             => null,          // set by createUserSession($id)
    'msg'                 => 'you are a guest',
    'uniqueId'            => 'a1b2c3d4e5f6', // 12-char hex, stable for session lifetime
    'ipPrefix'            => '192.168',     // first N octets (hijacking detection)
    'userAgent'           => 'Mozilla/…',
    'time_atRequest'      => 1749340800,    // unix timestamp of current request
    'time_sinceLastRequest' => 42,          // seconds since previous request

    // MPA only (when $appIsSpa = false):
    'allowedUrl'          => ['index.php', 'page2.php'],
    'urlIsAllowedToLoad'  => true,
];
```

All keys are under `$_SESSION['sessionadmin']`. The package never writes to other top-level `$_SESSION` keys (except `$keys` pre-seeding — see configuration).

## Installation

```bash
composer require seba1rx/sessionadmin
```

## Minimal implementation

`SessionAdmin` is abstract with no abstract methods. Extend it and set properties in the constructor:

```php
// App/MySession.php
namespace App;

use Seba1rx\SessionAdmin\SessionAdmin;

class MySession extends SessionAdmin
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->sessionName     = 'my_app';   // cookie name (default: 'SESSION')
        $this->sessionLifetime = 3600;        // idle timeout in seconds (default: 2400)
        $this->keys            = ['theme' => 'light']; // pre-seeded $_SESSION keys (optional)
    }
}
```

## Entry point — every PHP file that handles a request

```php
require 'vendor/autoload.php';

$session = new App\MySession();
$session->activateSession(); // replaces session_start()

// Check auth:
if (!empty($_SESSION['sessionadmin']['isUser'])) {
    $userId = $_SESSION['sessionadmin']['id_user'];
}

// On login:
$session->createUserSession($userId);

// On logout:
$session->terminate();
```

## Public API

| Method | Signature | Description |
|--------|-----------|-------------|
| `activateSession` | `(): void` | Starts or resumes the session. Runs all security checks, URL auth (MPA), and tab cleanup. Call instead of `session_start()`. |
| `createUserSession` | `(mixed $id): void` | Marks session as authenticated. Stores `$id` as `id_user`. Regenerates session ID. |
| `terminate` | `(): void` | Wipes session data, destroys session, restarts as guest. Redirects to `index.php` in MPA mode. |
| `setSessionHandler` | `(\SessionHandlerInterface $handler): void` | Plugs in a custom storage backend (Redis, DB, etc.). Call before `activateSession()`. |
| `setTabHandler` | `(TabHandlerInterface $handler): void` | Injects a per-tab session handler. Call before `activateSession()`. |

## Configuration properties

Set on the instance before calling `activateSession()`. Typically set in the constructor of your subclass.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `$sessionName` | `string` | `'SESSION'` | PHP session name and cookie name |
| `$sessionLifetime` | `int` | `2400` | Idle timeout in seconds |
| `$appIsSpa` | `bool` | `true` | Disables URL authorization and index redirect. Set to `false` for MPA. |
| `$useAuthorization` | `bool` | `false` | Enforces `$allowedUrls` check. Requires `$appIsSpa = false`. |
| `$allowedUrls` | `array` | `[]` | Filenames allowed to load for guests (MPA). Append to after login for private pages. |
| `$ignoreInAuthorization` | `array` | `[]` | Filenames that bypass URL authorization (auth handlers, logout endpoints). |
| `$ipOctetsToCheck` | `int` | `2` | Number of IP octets compared for hijacking detection (2–4). |
| `$proxyAwareIpDetection` | `bool` | `true` | Read IP from proxy headers (`X-Forwarded-For`, etc.). Set to `false` for `REMOTE_ADDR` only. |
| `$terminateRedirects` | `bool` | `true` | Whether `terminate()` redirects to `index.php` (MPA only). |
| `$keys` | `array` | `[]` | Key-value pairs pre-seeded into `$_SESSION` on first `activateSession()`. |
| `$autoCleanupTabs` | `int` | `0` | Seconds threshold for auto-pruning inactive tabs. Requires `setTabHandler()`. `0` disables. |

## SPA mode (default)

No configuration needed — `$appIsSpa = true` is the default. URL authorization is off. `terminate()` destroys the session and starts a fresh guest session without redirecting.

```php
class MySession extends SessionAdmin
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->sessionName     = 'my_spa';
        $this->sessionLifetime = 3600;
    }
}

$session = new MySession();
$session->activateSession();

// Auth check for AJAX endpoint:
if (empty($_SESSION['sessionadmin']['isUser'])) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'unauthenticated']);
    exit;
}
```

## MPA mode — URL authorization

Set `$appIsSpa = false` and `$useAuthorization = true`. Define which filenames guests may access in `$allowedUrls`. After login, append private pages to `$_SESSION['sessionadmin']['allowedUrl']`. Add auth-related files (login processor, logout) to `$ignoreInAuthorization` so they are never blocked.

```php
// AppFiles/required.php — include at the top of every page
require __DIR__ . '/../vendor/autoload.php';

$session = new App\MySession();
$session->appIsSpa              = false;
$session->useAuthorization      = true;
$session->allowedUrls           = ['index.php'];  // guest-accessible pages
$session->ignoreInAuthorization = ['login.php', 'logout.php']; // bypass URL check
$session->activateSession();
```

```php
// login.php — after credential validation
$session->createUserSession($userId);

// Grant access to private pages:
$_SESSION['sessionadmin']['allowedUrl'][] = 'dashboard.php';
$_SESSION['sessionadmin']['allowedUrl'][] = 'profile.php';
```

```php
// logout.php — must be in ignoreInAuthorization
$session->terminate(); // wipes session, redirects to index.php
```

**Important:** Any file that handles auth state transitions (login processor, logout handler) must be in `$ignoreInAuthorization`. If it is not, the URL check runs before `terminate()` or `createUserSession()` can execute, and the browser is redirected away before the action completes.

## Custom session storage

Pass any `\SessionHandlerInterface` implementation before `activateSession()`:

```php
$session = new App\MySession();
$session->setSessionHandler(new RedisSessionHandler($redis));
$session->activateSession();
```

The handler is registered via `session_set_save_handler()` with shutdown auto-close enabled.

## Security behaviors

**Hijacking detection:** On every request, the package compares the stored IP prefix and User-Agent against the incoming request. If either changed, the session is destroyed and a new guest session starts. The number of IP octets compared is controlled by `$ipOctetsToCheck` (2–4). With `$proxyAwareIpDetection = true`, the IP is read from proxy headers; with `false`, only `REMOTE_ADDR` is used.

**Session ID regeneration:** ID is always regenerated on login (`createUserSession()`). On subsequent requests, there is a ~3% chance of random regeneration to resist fixation and side-channel attacks.

**Lifetime enforcement:** If `time_sinceLastRequest` exceeds `$sessionLifetime`, the session is destroyed and a guest session starts. The check happens on every `activateSession()` call.

**URL authorization (MPA):** Compares `basename($_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'])` against `$allowedUrls`. Files in `$ignoreInAuthorization` are exempt. Unauthorized guests are redirected to `index.php`. Does not run in SPA mode.

## Contracts (interfaces)

**`Seba1rx\SessionAdmin\Contracts\SessionInterface`** — the public API contract. Type-hint against this to decouple consumers from the concrete class:

```php
use Seba1rx\SessionAdmin\Contracts\SessionInterface;

function boot(SessionInterface $session): void
{
    $session->activateSession();
}
```

Methods: `activateSession()`, `createUserSession(mixed $id)`, `terminate()`.

**`Seba1rx\SessionAdmin\Contracts\TabHandlerInterface`** — contract for per-tab session handlers. Implemented by `seba1rx/tabmanager` via `SessionAdminBridge`. Inject via `setTabHandler()`.

Methods: `indexNewTab()`, `touchTab()`, `set()`, `get()`, `isTabIndexed()`, `markInactiveTab()`, `destroyTabSession()`, `cleanupInactiveTabs()`.

## Integration with seba1rx/tabmanager

Per-browser-tab session isolation is provided by [`seba1rx/tabmanager`](https://packagist.org/packages/seba1rx/tabmanager). Install both:

```bash
composer require seba1rx/sessionadmin seba1rx/tabmanager
```

Use `SessionAdminBridge` (shipped with tabmanager) instead of `TabManager` directly. The bridge extends `TabManager` and implements `TabHandlerInterface`, but does **not** call `session_start()` in its constructor — `activateSession()` owns the session lifecycle.

### Wiring (every PHP entry point)

```php
use App\MySession;
use Seba1rx\TabManager\Bridge\SessionAdminBridge;

$session = new MySession();
$session->setTabHandler(new SessionAdminBridge()); // before activateSession()
$session->autoCleanupTabs = 30;                   // prune tabs inactive > 30 s (optional)
$session->activateSession();

// Tab-scoped storage (after JS client registers the tab):
$session->tabHandler->set('cart', $items);
$cart  = $session->tabHandler->get('cart');
$ready = $session->tabHandler->isTabIndexed(); // false until JS registers this tab
```

### Session data with tabmanager

Both packages write to distinct top-level keys and never collide:

```
$_SESSION
├── sessionadmin/   → auth, timing, security checks (managed by SessionAdmin)
└── tabmanager/     → per-tab data, last_active, is_active (managed by TabManager)
```

### Lifecycle ordering

```
$session->setTabHandler(new SessionAdminBridge())
  └─ bridge stores the store reference but does NOT call session_start()

$session->activateSession()
  ├─ session_name($this->sessionName)   ← session name applied before start
  ├─ session_set_cookie_params(…)
  ├─ session_start()                    ← session opens here
  ├─ … security checks …
  └─ $tabHandler->cleanupInactiveTabs($n)  ← tab cleanup runs after session is open
```

**Order matters.** `setTabHandler()` must be called before `activateSession()` so the bridge has access to the session once it starts.

### MySession with tabmanager

```php
class MySession extends SessionAdmin
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->sessionName     = 'my_app';
        $this->sessionLifetime = 3600;
        $this->autoCleanupTabs = 30; // run cleanupInactiveTabs(30) on every activateSession()
    }
}
```

### Tab-scoped data access

```php
// Write — visible only to the current browser tab
$session->tabHandler->set('wizard_step', 3);

// Read — returns null if tab not registered or key absent
$step = $session->tabHandler->get('wizard_step');

// Guard against unregistered tabs
if ($session->tabHandler->isTabIndexed()) {
    $session->tabHandler->set('ready', true);
}
```

### JS client integration

tabmanager's JS client sends a `X-TabManager-TabId` header on every AJAX request. The PHP bridge reads this header to route reads/writes to the correct session slot. Include `seba1rx_tabmanagerclient.js` (copied to project root by `composer install`):

```html
<head>
    <script src="/seba1rx_tabmanagerclient.js"></script>
</head>
```

Spread `TabManagerClient.getHeaders()` into every fetch call:

```js
await TabManagerClient.ready; // wait for UUID to be confirmed

const res = await fetch('/endpoint.php', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...TabManagerClient.getHeaders(), // X-TabManager-TabId: <uuid>
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
});
```

### Tab session loss (`autoCleanupTabs` + `tabmanager:session-lost`)

When `$autoCleanupTabs > 0`, SessionAdmin calls `cleanupInactiveTabs($n)` on every `activateSession()`. If the browser suspends a tab (Chrome Memory Saver, OS memory pressure), the JS heartbeat pauses and the tab may be pruned while invisible.

When the user returns to the tab, tabmanager's JS client fires a GET to `/tabmanager/tab-status`. If `indexed` is `false`, it dispatches `tabmanager:session-lost` on `document` and does **not** resume the heartbeat. The event carries `{ tabId: '<uuid>' }`.

```js
document.addEventListener('tabmanager:session-lost', (e) => {
    // e.detail.tabId — the UUID of the pruned tab
    // Heartbeat is already stopped. Show a warning or reload.
    showSessionLostBanner();
});
```

Override the status endpoint URL when using `php -S` (no router):

```html
<script>
    window.TABMANAGER_TAB_STATUS_URL = 'tab_status.php';
</script>
<script src="/seba1rx_tabmanagerclient.js"></script>
```

`tab_status.php` must start the session with the correct name before calling the static helper:

```php
// tab_status.php
$session = new App\MySession();                    // sets session name in constructor
$session->setTabHandler(new SessionAdminBridge());
$session->activateSession();                       // starts session with correct name

TabManager::handleTabStatusRequest();              // reads header, checks indexed, outputs JSON, exits
```

`TabManager::handleTabStatusRequest()` is a static `never`-returning method: it reads `X-TabManager-TabId`, validates the UUID, checks if the tab is registered in `$_SESSION`, outputs `{ "indexed": bool, "tab_id": "..." }`, and calls `exit`. It does **not** call `session_start()` — the caller owns the session setup.

### Bootstrap endpoints and custom session names

tabmanager auto-registers `/tabmanager/new-tab`, `/tabmanager/heartbeat`, `/tabmanager/tab-close`, and `/tabmanager/tab-status` via `bin/bootstrap.php`. These endpoints create `new TabManager()` internally, which opens a session with PHP's default name (`PHPSESSID`) unless the session name is set first.

If `$sessionName` is not the default, either:

**Option A** — set `session_name()` before the autoload in a front-controller that handles all requests:

```php
session_name('my_app'); // must match $this->sessionName
require 'vendor/autoload.php';
```

**Option B** — route tab registration, heartbeat, and tab-status requests through custom endpoint files that call `$session->activateSession()` first (as the `demo/tabmanager/` demo does with `session.php`, `heartbeat.php`, and `tab_status.php`).

## Testing

```bash
composer test
```

Tests use a concrete subclass of `SessionAdmin` with overrides for `setCookie()`, `getCookie()`, and `redirectToIndex()` so no real HTTP headers or exits occur. PHPUnit stubs/mocks are used for `TabHandlerInterface` — no concrete `TabManager` dependency in tests.

```php
// Mock pattern for TabHandlerInterface in tests
$handler = $this->createMock(TabHandlerInterface::class);
$handler->expects($this->once())
        ->method('cleanupInactiveTabs')
        ->with(30);

$session = new MyTestSession();
$session->setTabHandler($handler);
$session->autoCleanupTabs = 30;
$session->activateSession();
```

## Common mistakes

| Mistake | Consequence | Fix |
|---------|-------------|-----|
| Not extending `SessionAdmin` | Cannot instantiate — abstract class | Always extend and define a constructor |
| Calling `session_start()` before `activateSession()` | Session name and cookie params not applied | Remove manual `session_start()`; `activateSession()` handles it |
| Logout file not in `$ignoreInAuthorization` (MPA) | URL check runs before `terminate()`, redirects away | Add logout filename to `$ignoreInAuthorization` |
| Calling `setSessionHandler()` after `activateSession()` | Handler not applied — session already open | Always call before `activateSession()` |
| Calling `setTabHandler()` after `activateSession()` | Handler set but cleanup already ran; session name may not match | Always call before `activateSession()` |
| Using `TabManager` directly instead of `SessionAdminBridge` | `TabManager` calls `session_start()` in constructor, before session name is set | Use `SessionAdminBridge` when integrating with sessionadmin |
| Omitting `TabManagerClient.getHeaders()` in a fetch | Cookie fallback used; all tabs share same session slot | Always spread headers into every AJAX request |
| Reading tab data before `await TabManagerClient.ready` | `tab.id` is `null`; requests fail silently | Await `TabManagerClient.ready` before any tab operation |
| Setting `$autoCleanupTabs` without calling `setTabHandler()` | Property is ignored — no handler to clean up | Both must be set; `autoCleanupTabs > 0` is only meaningful with a handler |
